name: Merge PDF
summary: Combine drawings, attachments, and reports in your chosen order.
answer: Combine two or more PDFs into a single file. Add your files, arrange them, and save a new PDF.
steps: Choose your source files.
Arrange files in the order they should appear.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Interactive forms are flattened in the combined copy; document bookmarks and signatures are not preserved.

name: Split PDF
summary: Separate a PDF into individual pages or page groups.
answer: Split a PDF into separate files by page count. Choose how many pages belong in each output, then download the group as a ZIP.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the number of pages per file.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Each output contains the selected source pages; interactive form values become static.

name: Extract PDF pages
summary: Pull the exact sheets you need into a new PDF.
answer: Extract selected PDF pages using page numbers and ranges such as 1, 3-5. The original file stays unchanged.
steps: Choose your source files.
Enter the pages you want to keep.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: PDF page numbers count from 1 and may differ from printed drawing numbers.

name: Delete PDF pages
summary: Remove obsolete sheets and unwanted pages from a copy.
answer: Remove selected pages from a PDF and download the remaining pages as a new file. At least one page must remain.
steps: Choose your source files.
Enter the pages to remove.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Check the result before replacing an issued drawing set.

name: Organize PDF
summary: Rearrange pages with a clear, numbered page order.
answer: Reorder PDF pages by entering their new sequence. Use every page once to change order, or use Extract for a subset.
steps: Choose your source files.
Set the page order with the up and down controls.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Page numbers refer to the original file, not the position after reordering.

fields.label: Page order
fields.help: Include every page once, separated by commas.

name: Rotate PDF
summary: Turn sideways or upside-down pages the right way.
answer: Rotate selected PDF pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees clockwise. Leave the page range blank to rotate every page.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose pages and a clockwise rotation.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Rotation changes viewing orientation without rasterizing page artwork.

name: Duplicate PDF pages
summary: Repeat a form or drawing without copying an entire file.
answer: Duplicate selected PDF pages directly after their originals. Choose how many extra copies to add per selected page.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the pages and number of extra copies.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Form values in copied pages become static to prevent conflicting field names.

name: Reverse PDF pages
summary: Correct a scan that arrived back to front.
answer: Reverse the order of every page in a PDF, so the last page becomes the first. Download a separate corrected copy.
steps: Choose your source files.
Check the source page count.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: This changes page order, not the orientation of each page.

name: Insert blank pages
summary: Add space for notes, separators, or duplex printing.
answer: Insert blank pages before or after a chosen PDF page. New pages match the selected page size.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the insertion point and blank-page count.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Inserted pages contain no fields or artwork.

name: Interleave PDFs
summary: Combine front and back scans in alternating order.
answer: Interleave two PDFs by alternating pages from each file. Reverse the second file when the back-side scan is in reverse order.
steps: Choose your source files.
Place front pages first and back pages second.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: If the files have different page counts, remaining pages are appended.

name: JPG to PDF
summary: Turn photos and scans into a neatly sized PDF.
answer: Convert JPG images into PDF pages in your chosen order. Keep the image proportions and select A4, Letter, or original image size.
steps: Choose your source files.
Add JPG images and choose the page size.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Image-size mode uses 96 pixels per inch; verify scale before using a converted drawing for measurements.

name: PNG to PDF
summary: Collect PNG screenshots and drawings into one PDF.
answer: Convert PNG images to a PDF in the browser, retaining transparency and image proportions. Choose page size and margins.
steps: Choose your source files.
Arrange PNG images and select a page size.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: A PDF wrapper does not turn a raster drawing into vector geometry.

name: WebP to PDF
summary: Make downloaded WebP images easier to share and print.
answer: Convert WebP images into PDF pages locally. The images are decoded to PNG before embedding in the output PDF.
steps: Choose your source files.
Add WebP files and select a page size.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Animated WebP input uses the decoded first frame only.

name: PDF to JPG
summary: Export selected pages as shareable JPEG images.
answer: Convert PDF pages to JPG images at your chosen resolution. Download one image or a ZIP containing every selected page.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose pages, resolution, and JPEG quality.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: JPEG is lossy and removes selectable text; use PNG for crisp linework.

name: PDF to PNG
summary: Create crisp page images for reports and review.
answer: Render PDF pages as PNG images in the browser. Select pages and resolution, then download the images together.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose pages and image resolution.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: PNG preserves rendered pixels, not editable PDF objects or measurement calibration.

name: PDF to WebP
summary: Export lightweight page images for the web.
answer: Render selected PDF pages as WebP images with a quality setting. Export one image or download multiple pages as a ZIP.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose pages, resolution, and WebP quality.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: WebP output is a page image, not an editable or searchable PDF.

name: PDF to text
summary: Extract selectable text with page boundaries intact.
answer: Extract a PDF’s existing text layer to a UTF-8 text file. Page markers help you trace each section back to its source.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the pages to extract.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Scanned pages without a text layer need OCR, which this browser tool does not perform. Reading order can differ on complex drawings.

name: Text to PDF
summary: Make a clean, paginated PDF from your notes.
answer: Convert plain text into a readable PDF with automatic line wrapping and page breaks. Add a title and choose a font size.
steps: Start with plain text.
Type or paste your text and choose its size.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: The built-in font supports Latin characters; unsupported characters are rejected rather than silently changed.

name: Compress PDF
summary: Reduce size with a choice between structural and image compression.
answer: Compress a PDF locally using lossless structural rewriting or a smaller, image-based copy. The result shows the actual size change.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose lossless or image compression.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Image compression removes selectable text, links, forms, and vector detail. Lossless rewriting may not make an already optimized file smaller.

name: Flatten PDF forms
summary: Make filled form values part of the page.
answer: Flatten standard PDF form fields into static page content. Filled values remain visible but are no longer editable form fields.
steps: Choose your source files.
Check filled values in the preview before flattening.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: This flattens AcroForm fields, not every comment or layer. XFA forms and signed PDFs are unsupported.

name: Fill PDF forms
summary: Fill existing text fields, choices, and checkboxes.
answer: Fill standard PDF forms locally, then download an interactive copy. The field list is read from your PDF, not guessed from its appearance.
steps: Choose your source files.
Complete the detected fields.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Scans and flat PDFs have no interactive fields. XFA and signed forms are unsupported.

name: Extract form data
summary: Export field names, values, types, and options as JSON.
answer: Read standard PDF form fields and export their current values as JSON. Use this record to review entries or prepare an automated workflow.
steps: Choose your source files.
Inspect the detected fields and export the data.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: This reports AcroForm fields; it does not infer fields from a scan or assess signature validity.

name: Remove PDF annotations
summary: Remove review comments while retaining form fields and links.
answer: Remove PDF comments and markup annotations from selected pages. Interactive fields and link annotations remain in the file.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the pages whose comments should be removed.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Artwork already flattened into page content cannot be removed by this tool. This is not secure redaction.

name: Watermark PDF
summary: Label a review copy with a visible text watermark.
answer: Add a translucent text watermark to selected PDF pages. Choose the text, size, color, and opacity before exporting a copy.
steps: Choose your source files.
Enter watermark text and select its appearance.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Watermarks are visible labels, not copy protection or redaction.

name: Number PDF pages
summary: Add consistent page numbers to a document.
answer: Add sequential page numbers to selected PDF pages. Choose a starting number, prefix, and header or footer placement.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the starting number and position.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Numbers are added to page artwork and do not change PDF page labels or drawing sheet identifiers.

name: Bates numbering
summary: Give document pages stable, padded identifiers.
answer: Add Bates numbers to a PDF using a prefix, starting number, and fixed digit count. Export a review copy with consecutive identifiers.
steps: Choose your source files.
Set the prefix, starting number, and digit count.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Bates numbers identify pages; they do not certify completeness or replace a document-control register.

name: Crop PDF
summary: Trim the visible page boundary by equal or different margins.
answer: Crop PDF pages by setting margins in points, where 72 points equal one inch. The crop changes the visible page boundary.
steps: Choose your source files.
Set top, right, bottom, and left margins.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Cropped content remains in the PDF. Do not use cropping to remove sensitive information.

name: Resize PDF pages
summary: Fit pages to A4, Letter, A3, or Tabloid without stretching.
answer: Resize PDF pages to a standard paper size while preserving artwork proportions. Content is centered on the new page.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the target paper size.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Resizing changes drawing scale. Recalibrate and check a known dimension before measuring.

name: Add PDF margins
summary: Create a clean border for binding, printing, or notes.
answer: Add equal white margins around PDF pages without scaling the existing page artwork. Choose the border width in points.
steps: Choose your source files.
Enter the margin width.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: The page size increases. Print at actual size to retain the artwork’s original scale.

name: Make a PDF booklet
summary: Arrange pages for a folded, saddle-stitched booklet.
answer: Arrange PDF pages in booklet order, two pages per landscape sheet. Blank panels pad the document to a multiple of four.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose the output paper size.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Print double-sided with short-edge flipping and test one sheet first; printer settings vary.

name: Multiple pages per sheet
summary: Put two or four source pages on each output sheet.
answer: Create a two-up or four-up PDF contact sheet. Source pages retain their proportions and are placed in reading order.
steps: Choose your source files.
Choose two or four pages and the sheet size.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Reduced drawing pages are for review; their printed scale changes.

name: Add text to PDF
summary: Place a note, date, or label on a PDF page.
answer: Add a new text label to selected PDF pages. Set its position from the top-left corner using percentages of the visible page.
steps: Choose your source files.
Enter a label and choose its placement.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: This adds text; it does not edit or erase existing text. The built-in font supports Latin characters.

name: Add image to PDF
summary: Place a logo, stamp, or signature image on a page.
answer: Add a JPG or PNG image to selected PDF pages while preserving its proportions. Set its position and width as page percentages.
steps: Choose your source files.
Add a PDF first, then the image to place.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: A pasted signature image is not a cryptographic digital signature or a signature-request workflow.

name: Edit PDF metadata
summary: Set the document title, author, subject, and keywords.
answer: Edit a PDF’s standard document information fields locally. Replace the title, author, subject, and keywords, then save a copy.
steps: Choose your source files.
Enter the standard metadata values you want to keep.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: This is not a privacy scrubber: embedded files, XMP, comments, and page content can retain other information.

name: Inspect PDF
summary: Check page sizes, rotation, form fields, and metadata.
answer: Inspect PDF page count, page dimensions, rotation, standard metadata, and form fields. Export a machine-readable JSON report.
steps: Choose your source files.
Review the page and document information.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: Inspection does not certify accessibility, archival compliance, signature validity, or drawing scale.

name: Compare PDF text
summary: Find changed text between two versions of a document.
answer: Compare the existing text layers of two PDFs page by page. Export a JSON report of added and removed lines with page references.
steps: Choose your source files.
Add the older PDF first and the newer PDF second.
Run the tool, review the result, and download your copy.
limitation: This is a text comparison, not a visual overlay. Scans without text and geometry-only changes are not detected.
